rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that cannot be noticed or detected.

example.english: This tiny change is truly imperceptible.
example.traditional: 呢個細微嘅變化真係察覺唔到嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai3 mei4 ge3 bin3 faa3 zan1 hai6 caat3 gok3 m4 dou2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the imperceptible thing is a physical sensation or other sensory signal.

example.english: After the anaesthetic, even slight numbness in my leg was imperceptible.
example.traditional: 打咗麻醉針之後，隻腳有少少麻痺都感覺唔到嘅。
example.jyutping: daa2 zo2 maa4 zeoi3 zam1 zi1 hau6 zek3 goek3 jau5 siu2 siu2 maa4 bei3 dou1 gam2 gok3 m4 dou2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a detail or change that is so inconspicuous that people do not notice it visually or attentively.

example.english: They changed the painting while we were not paying attention, and the alteration was imperceptible.
example.traditional: 佢趁我哋唔留神換咗幅畫，個改動好唔覺眼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 can3 ngo5 dei6 m4 lau4 san4 wun6 zo2 fuk1 waak6 go3 goi2 dung6 hou2 m4 gok3 ngaan5
